items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Richard Rodney Bennett sent me a lyric he had written

ctx.x: I wrote that totally to a lyric, Richard Rodney Bennett sent me a lyric he had written, you know Richard Rodney Bennett’s a rather famous composer in his own right and a wonderful film composer. He had written, you know, Equus, also for Sidney Lumet, Far From the Madding Crowd…
